ai.headline: Zoom widens its definition of Customer Content and what account owners can access
ai.summary: Zoom's privacy statement now defines Customer Content as including content from other Zoom products and services you subscribe to, not just meetings, webinars, and messages. Account owners may also see more recordings and transcripts, including ones shared with users on their account, and meeting participants may now record and share meeting content. Zoom still says its employees do not access Customer Content without authorization or for legal, safety, security, or support purposes, and that it does not use this content to train its AI models.
